content: भोजन {%a.%} [भुज्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] .²1 Feeding, nourishing, giving to eat. .²2 Voracious; (राक्षसी) अङ्गारकेति विख्याता छायामाक्षिप्य भोजनी <ls>Rām. 4. 41. 26</ls>. .{@-नः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²2 Of Śiva. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Eating, eating food; taking oneʼs meals; अजीर्णे भोजनं विषम्. .²2 Food. .²3 Giving (food) to eat, feeding. .²4 Using, enjoying. .²5 Any object of enjoyment. .²6 That which is enjoyed; सहानुजैः प्रत्यवरुद्धभोजनः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 10. 1</ls>. .²7 Property, wealth, possessions.
